focus: Audit sk-code-ci skill, router, references and assets for rendering defects, content placement and reader-oriented order against sk-doc templates.
noveltyJustification: Both findings are new, source-confirmed CI surface examples of duplicated introductory content and router detail.
keyQuestions: Which rendering defects occur in each sk-code area, and where are they visible?
Which references and assets diverge from their respective template structure or place content poorly?
Which section and item sequences follow authoring history instead of a reader task?
Why did the templates, authoring guidance and validator miss each defect class?
Which fixes belong in templates, guidance or validation, and which checks can run mechanically?
ruledOut: The CI Markdown scan found no confirmed post-frontmatter setext headings, consecutive standalone bold-label lines, bare URLs or empty OVERVIEW sections. The initial empty-overview candidates were scanner-boundary false positives and were not reported as source defects.
